description: Applied manually in Cloudflare. Must run before any verified-profile Skip rule: that rule skips all remaining custom rules. Block the existing unwanted scraper list and a narrowly matched automated Chromium fingerprint from AS14061 on public hostnames. Verified search crawlers are excluded from the new browser condition; verified Applebot search remains allowed.
expression: ((http.user_agent contains "Lightpanda") or (http.user_agent contains "ExaSearchBot") or (http.user_agent contains "SemrushBot") or (http.user_agent contains "Sogou") or (http.user_agent contains "Applebot-Extended") or ((http.user_agent contains "Applebot") and not cf.client.bot)) or (ip.src.asnum eq 14061 and not cf.client.bot and http.host in {"www.freecause.com" "freecause.com"} and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.user_agent contains "X11; Linux x86_64" and (http.user_agent contains "Chrome/146.0.0.0" or http.user_agent contains "Chrome/152.0.0.0") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and http.request.uri.path ne "/up")

rollback.expression: (http.user_agent contains "Lightpanda") or (http.user_agent contains "ExaSearchBot") or (http.user_agent contains "SemrushBot") or (http.user_agent contains "Sogou") or (http.user_agent contains "Applebot-Extended") or ((http.user_agent contains "Applebot") and not cf.client.bot)
